meta.description: Guidances extraites des communiqués de résultats (8-K Item 2.02, SEC)

guidances.libelle: croissance organique du chiffre d'affaires à devises constantes pour l'exercice
guidances.citation: The Company is raising its full-year 2026 organic constant currency revenue growth guidance to the range of 9.1% to 9.7%.

guidances.libelle: chiffre d'affaires organique publié pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: Including the effect of currency translation, full-year 2026 organic reported revenue is expected to be in the range of $3.429 billion to $3.447 billion.

guidances.libelle: chiffre d'affaires publié des activités acquises pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: The Company is raising its acquired business revenue expectation and now expects full-year 2026 acquired business reported revenue of approximately $3.050 billion on an owned-period basis.

guidances.libelle: chiffre d'affaires total publié pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: Total Company reported revenue for full-year 2026 is expected to be in the range of $6.479 billion to $6.497 billion.

guidances.libelle: bénéfice par action ajusté pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: The Company is updating its full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to the range of $14.60 to $14.70,

guidances.libelle: croissance organique du chiffre d'affaires à devises constantes pour le T4 2026
guidances.citation: The Company expects fourth quarter 2026 organic constant currency revenue growth to be in the range of 7.0% to 9.0%.

guidances.libelle: chiffre d'affaires publié des activités acquises pour le T4 2026
guidances.citation: The Company expects acquired business reported revenue for the fourth quarter of 2026 to be approximately $817 million.

guidances.libelle: chiffre d'affaires total publié pour le T4 2026
guidances.citation: Total Company reported revenue for the fourth quarter of 2026 is expected to be in the range of $1.801 billion to $1.819 billion.

guidances.libelle: bénéfice par action ajusté pour le T4 2026
guidances.citation: The Company expects fourth quarter 2026 adjusted EPS to be in the range of $4.58 to $4.68, which represents 1% to 3% year-over-year adjusted EPS growth.
